title: PEBR poll witness (coverage/publication)
description: One retrieval/coverage of a poll. Multiple witnesses may merge into one canonical poll. poll_id may be null until identity linking runs. parser_id is config-driven (never self-modifying).

poll_id.description: Linked canonical poll after identity merge; null until linked.

source_url.description: URL of this coverage (http/https or stable archive URI).

content_hash.description: Hash of retrieved bytes (e.g. sha256 hex).

raw_path.description: Repo-relative path to stored raw artifact, if any.

parser_id.description: Config-driven parser key from reproducible mappings — never a self-modifying parser.

extractions.description: Parser output blob; structure evolves under parser_id versioning. Prefer empty object over invented fields.

tse_registration_id.description: If this witness is/carries a TSE registration reference — provenance only.
